blind_spots_patched: Baseline Ch 3 claimed no single distributor holds leverage over Chubb, omitting that Marsh & McLennan alone placed ~11% of consolidated GPW in FY2023-FY2025, while also omitting the $1.75B U.S. per-occurrence cat retention and $20,611M net reinsurance recoverable concentration (incl. $1,463M Brandywine run-off).
